paper.title: OceanNet: a principled neural operator-based digital twin for regional oceans
paper.conclusion_note: All 26 staging claims were reviewed against the publisher article and a hash-pinned author manuscript, with the supplement kept separate. This is not a complete-paper attestation: experiment granularity, two underspecified architecture values, one extraction note embedded in a value, one AI interpretation, and one invalid provenance class remain unresolved.

claims.extracted_value: Regional SSH forecasting of Gulf Stream and Loop Current eddies
claims.evidence_summary: The article applies OceanNet to seasonal prediction of Loop Current eddies and the Gulf Stream meander using SSH.
claims.audit_note: Supported; page refers to the hash-pinned author manuscript, while the publisher HTML has no page numbers.

claims.extracted_value: Northwest Atlantic regional ROMS reanalysis with EnKF assimilation
claims.evidence_summary: The training reanalysis is a regional ROMS implementation using EnKF.
The model input is the historical five-day-mean SSH state X(t).
The labels are future SSH states at domain-specific lead times.
Both domain training datasets span 1993 through 2018.
SSH forecasting is conducted for 2019 and 2020.

claims.extracted_value: Training uses five-day-mean SSH; Gulf of Mexico 5-day lead, Gulf Stream 4-day lead
claims.evidence_summary: Five-day averaging and the GoM five-day and GS four-day lead times are all explicit, but they describe different concepts and experiments.
claims.audit_note: Split temporal resolution from experiment-specific forecast leads; MAIN_EXPERIMENT is too coarse.

claims.extracted_value: Underlying regional ROMS reanalysis: 4 km horizontal and 50 vertical layers
claims.evidence_summary: The reanalysis has 4 km horizontal resolution and 50 vertical layers.
claims.audit_note: Supported; the vertical-layer count is not itself a horizontal spatial resolution and should remain separately modeled.

claims.extracted_value: Fourier neural operator with predictor-evaluate-corrector time integrator
claims.evidence_summary: OceanNet combines an FNO and a PEC integration scheme.
The FNO has four Fourier layers; the complete network also contains convolutional layers.
claims.audit_note: The bare value 4 must not be interpreted as total model layers.

claims.evidence_summary: Each Fourier layer retains 64 Fourier modes.
claims.corrected_value: 64 Fourier modes retained per Fourier layer

claims.evidence_summary: The paper reports approximately 80 million trainable FNO parameters.
claims.audit_note: Supported and correctly scoped to the FNO.

claims.extracted_value: Two convolutions lift input state to latent channels
claims.evidence_summary: Two convolutional layers lift the input state into a higher-dimensional representation.

claims.extracted_value: Two convolutions map latent features to forecast state
claims.evidence_summary: Two final convolutional layers restore the forecast-state dimension.
The paper defines the PEC operations and predicted state explicitly.
MSE is computed exclusively at ocean grid points.
claims.audit_note: Supported; 'masked' is an accurate compact description of the stated ocean-only evaluation.

claims.extracted_value: Penalty on mismatch of latitude-averaged zonal Fourier spectra for selected wavenumbers
claims.evidence_summary: The regularizer compares latitude-averaged zonal Fourier spectra over kx greater than or equal to kT.

claims.extracted_value: Spectral coefficient lambda included in combined two-step loss; numeric lambda not transcribed
claims.locator: Equations (6)-(7); full main-paper and separate supplement review
claims.evidence_summary: A symbolic lambda multiplies the spectral term; no numeric lambda was located in the main paper or three-page supplement.
claims.audit_note: Remove the extraction-process phrase from the scientific value. Code was not inspected, so absence is scoped only to paper and supplement.

claims.evidence_summary: The total objective adds the two time-step losses.
The cutoff wavenumber kT is 100 after trial and error.

claims.extracted_value: Reduced state dynamics dX/dt=F(X(t)); F approximated by FNO
claims.evidence_summary: The reduced-state equation is stated and the FNO parameterizes F.

claims.extracted_value: Physics-inspired learned tendency/integrator and spectral regularization; not demonstrated PDE-residual PINN
claims.evidence_summary: The learned tendency, PEC integrator, and spectral regularizer are explicit; the negative PINN classification is interpretive.
claims.audit_note: Keep AI_INTERPRETATION and do not promote to an author-reported fact.

extracted_value: modified Hausdorff distance for eddy shape
claims.evidence_summary: RMSE, correlation coefficient, and modified Hausdorff distance are explicitly defined as evaluation metrics.

claims.extracted_value: Forecast skill reported up to 90-120 days; substantially faster runtime than regional dynamical model
claims.evidence_summary: The paper evaluates 90-120 day forecasts and reports approximately 500,000-times faster execution.
claims.audit_note: Supported; the staging wording is less precise than the paper but not stronger.

claims.extracted_value: No explicit lateral open-ocean boundary condition
claims.evidence_summary: The absence of lateral open-ocean boundary conditions is called a major shortcoming.

claims.extracted_value: Add additional prognostic variables and address long-term/open-boundary regimes
claims.evidence_summary: The authors propose additional variables and explain when accurate open boundaries become crucial.
claims.audit_note: Value is supported, but AUTHOR_REPORTED_FUTURE_WORK is outside the project provenance enum.

supplement_findings: The supplement separately reports a U-Net baseline, an FNO without the spectral regularizer or PEC, and a geostrophic-constraint experiment.
No staging claim was allowed to cite the supplement as if it were the main paper.
The supplement contains no numeric value for the spectral coefficient lambda.
unresolved: The GitHub code repository was declared by the paper but was not inspected or executed.
The publisher HTML has no page numbering; manuscript page numbers are explicitly tied to the hash-pinned arXiv v2 source.
No complete-paper extraction coverage assessment exists for the staging or canonical contracts.
No new global NOT_REPORTED decision was made beyond the explicitly scoped paper-plus-supplement lambda search.
